value.rationale: A canonical, natural geometric invariant (the full shortest-support-normal set of a poset order-polytope difference body) is classified for all finite posets, not an ad hoc parameter slice. Two canonical symmetric poset bodies share the same optimal radius yet have exponentially different tangent-normal counts. A sharp factor-two gap screens all discarded longest-chain signs. This geometric equality phenomenon is not determined by the earlier scalar radius and supplies a complete structural distinction.
